comment: Answer key for the 16-item calibration dataset. `line` is the bug line in the SEEDED tree state (the `dataset tree state` commit in this branch's history); `fn` is the grading match key. diff.patch in each item dir is the exact hunk set shown to finder agents. Items c1/c2/c3 are benign-only code diffs (correctness-lens FP controls); c4 is a legitimate computed-value tripwire test (test-integrity-lens FP control).

items.bug: handle_schedule discards the event-queue push result (`let _ = sender.push(ev);`) instead of returning ScheduleResult::Err on a full queue, so a dropped schedule batch is reported as Ok { accepted }.

The 4-byte length-prefix read is `r.read_exact(&mut prefix_buf).unwrap()` instead of `?`, so a truncated prefix / peer disconnect panics the reader thread in a fn that otherwise returns FrameError on every I/O path.

Shelf-height accumulator drops the padding term (`.max(height)` vs `.max(padded_height)`), losing the one-pixel GLYPH_PADDING gutter between atlas rows; bilinear sampling bleeds neighboring glyphs across shelf boundaries.

A let-chain restructured into a nested if whose visited-recipient guard `continue`s before `collected.push(entry)`, so a Sent to an already-visited mailbox (any reply/ping-pong hop) silently vanishes from the stitched trace tree.

Vec-arm pre-allocation clamp is `len.min(cur.bytes.len())` (total input) instead of `len.min(cur.remaining())` (unconsumed bytes), so a wire-supplied length at a late cursor position over-allocates against the whole buffer; the adjacent comment still says 'against the bytes that remain'.

`self.dirty = true` hoisted above the bounds/length validation and not rolled back on the two early `return false` paths — a rejected update leaves a stale dirty flag forcing a spurious full GPU re-upload at next record.

Decreasing-sample EWMA branch computes `sample + α·(prev − sample)` instead of `prev − α·(prev − sample)`, anchoring at the new sample so one fast settle collapses the average by weight 1−α instead of α — contradicting the adjacent `next = prev ± α·|sample − prev|` comment.

Pan normalization divides by 128.0 instead of 127.0 (ADR-0127 asymmetry inverted): pan=127 maps to 0.992 not 1.0, hard right keeps a ~-44 dB left residue, and the clamp becomes dead code on the right side.

items.provenance: real bug #3247 (fixed by 8047ed68), re-seeded by reverting the guard; its regression test component_config_path_oversized_is_rejected_up_front removed from the tree for the run
items.bug: config_path is fs::read fully into memory with no max_frame_size() bound — an oversized file is read whole and only rejected downstream at frame encode; the sibling $file sigil-embed path (resolve_bytes_embed) enforces the cap up front.

items.provenance: real bug (fixed by 3052c7bf 'preserve script state during restore'), re-seeded by restoring the pre-fix order; its tripwire test offer_state_round_trips_prior_blob_through_restore removed from the tree for the run
items.bug: offer_state arms fuel AFTER write_guest; on the only call path (instantiate) the store is fresh with zero fuel, so the guest alloc inside write_guest traps, write_guest returns None, and the prior-state blob is silently dropped on every restore.
Junk mirror test: asserts Mat4Apply::NAME against the same literal the #[kind(name)] attribute declares — no independent truth.
Junk derive-only roundtrip: decode(encode(x)) over FontMetrics whose Serialize/Deserialize/Schema are plain derives — exercises only aether-data's codec, no aether-kinds logic.
